title: Nito delivers his latest Track, "Abroad"
htmlContent:
Brazilian-Orlando-based music star Nito is a talented singer and songwriter who was once known for his athletic career but is now known for his super dope sound and creative flows. The talented star releases his latest track, "Abroad."

Nito's "Abroad" is an uptempo melodic vibe song similar to Young thug and lil Keed in terms of energy. Well known for his blending of genres, he has once again put his audience on edge, leading multiple audiences to get the opportunity to listen to a spectrum of genres within just one song.
